templates.title: Message templates
templates.help: Write the body of a message notification yourself. Leave a field empty to keep the default body. Variables are replaced once, and one that is not in the list stays as typed. The text policy still applies: {text} is empty when the policy hides the message text.
templates.markdownNote: This channel sends Markdown: text from the mesh is escaped, your own Markdown in the template is kept.
templates.plainNote: The preview is shown as plain text. On a channel that sends Markdown, text from the mesh is escaped and your own Markdown in the template is kept.

errors.template_too_long: A template is limited to {{max}} characters.
errors.template_invalid: This template is not valid (control characters are not allowed).
errors.template_unsupported: This type of channel does not take message templates.
